Overview

A resort
born from
movement

Brand Identity Visual System Typography Iconography Signage Collateral

Masar Resort is NEOM's Sports Village — a destination where world-class athletics meets immersive hospitality. The brand needed to capture both the energy of sport and the elegance of a premium resort experience.

We developed a complete visual identity system rooted in motion and nature. The iconic symbol — inspired by sunrays and the movement of athletes — functions across multiple color systems: a vibrant multi-color palette for the resort experience, a premium gold version for luxury touchpoints, and a monochrome system for versatile applications.

The typographic system balances a fluid, sporty wordmark in English with a beautifully crafted Arabic counterpart — ensuring the brand communicates equally across both cultures and audiences.
